defects.summary: The shared Unconfined caveat is rewritten in both halves and in the json header ('a shell is always there' becomes 'its tools reach outside the folder…'), so every Codex row's user-facing text changes too; no story asks for this and deviations 50–57 do not record it, although the old text was false for Kimi.
After the caveat change, the Unconfined enum doc (:14) still says 'a shell is always there (F2)', so it no longer agrees with the rewritten standing description in shared/runtime-capabilities.json.
Deviation 56 calls S5.6.7 'a Theory of three endings', but the test has four (it adds 'launch-refused'), and no deviation records that extra arm or the new PlayedKimi.Version seam.
E5.6 decision 2 says each Kimi row's note carries the version 2.1.1, but the web row's note leaves it out, and this is not recorded.
S5.5.1's path checks are loose: --cwd only has to contain 'own/tree', and the home's '<8>' parent segment is never checked for shape.
A blank line between two properties is deleted for no reason, which breaks the file's spacing.
The new caveat test calls itself 'R1', a label that clashes with E5.3's R1–R11 security judgement and points to no recorded decision.
